newsitem.title: USA: TGX Corp plans merger with GeoStrat Resources.
newsitem.headline: TGX Corp plans merger with GeoStrat Resources.

text.p: TGX Corp said Monday it had filed a registration statement about its merger with its wholly owned subsidiary, GeoStrat Resources Inc, in order to effect a recapitalization of its existing security holders.
TGX said holders of its Series A Senior Preferred Stock would receive one-half share of GeoStrat common stock for each preferred share they held.
Other series of TGX command and preferred stock would be eliminated after the merger, it added.
TGX said it would present its merger and recapitalization proposals to its shareholders at a special meeting in mid- October.
It said the merger would give GeoStrat flexibility and liquidity as well as allow it to raise more capital.
